A.decision: Not a mint silent loss. Compile listPadding 4/0/4/0 survived on every open listbox including empty/loading. Do not remint. Do not invent 8/14/16 or optionPadding on empty/loading to look nicer. Raw-library 14/16 and AntD empty optionPadding were never carried compile facts.
